review.use_summary: Applied recovery-curve cisTarget motif enrichment to cluster hypo-DMRs, normalized motif AUC against the motif collection, and selected motifs with AUC>0.01 and NES>3.
review.implementation_scope_note: The two10th-quantile mCG filters define each input DMR set. TF expression>0 and normalized mCH<1 in at least one enriched cluster are separate biological postfilters. Native ranked-feature AUC/NES requires the complete declared motif background and explicit strict thresholds; it does not score DNA, infer the paper database/edition, select DMRs or apply expression/methylation filters.

review.use_summary: Used SCENIC grn, ctx with nes_threshold2.5 and min_genes10, then aucell for SPN regulon activity; downloaded mouse TF resources and the v9 mouse motif-annotation collection from cisTarget resources.
review.implementation_scope_note: The cisTarget-resource URL and SCENIC ctx invocation do not identify a separately executed cisTarget package or its edition. Coexpression inference, motif annotation/TF filtering, minimum regulon size, AUCell and cluster averaging/scaling remain pipeline operations. A native ranked-feature enrichment calculation does not reproduce this SCENIC workflow.

review.use_summary: Ran cisTarget separately on positively and negatively correlated DMR sets for each TF, selected motifs at NES>3, and used leading-edge analysis to assign motif occurrence from Cluster-Buster scores.
review.implementation_scope_note: Positive and negative DMR sets must remain separate. Native prepared-ranking AUC/NES and exact leading-target membership do not generate Cluster-Buster scores, infer the original database/edition or reconstruct TF-DMR edge selection. The paper does not resolve Python versus R cutoff/SD conventions; select a documented source profile explicitly rather than inferring historical parity.

prior_review.use_summary: Enriched TF motifs in correlated DMR sets using NES thresholds.
prior_review.implementation_scope_note: Native recovery AUC alone does not implement cisTarget normalization and regulatory-target analysis.

review.use_summary: Compared TF-Modisco patterns with the cisTarget motif collection using Tomtom to identify similar TF binding sites.
review.implementation_scope_note: This is motif-collection use through Tomtom, not evidence of a cisTarget enrichment execution. Preserve the motif-collection identity and Tomtom settings as separate requirements. Native cisTarget enrichment does not implement TF-Modisco, Tomtom motif comparison or annotation transfer.

review.use_summary: Supplied precomputed human cisTarget ranking and score databases plus the SCENIC+ motif collection to the SCENIC+ eGRN pipeline with a2Mb search space on each side of gene TSSs.
review.implementation_scope_note: SEACells0.3.3 metacells, pycisTopic2.0a0 topic/candidate-region analysis and Scanpy1.8.2 RNA preprocessing are separate steps. The source does not identify an independently run cisTarget package edition. Native motif-ranking enrichment does not consume score databases as ranks or reproduce SCENIC+ eGRNs, enhancer-gene linking or the default pipeline.

review.use_summary: Used pySCENIC0.12.1 with GRNBoost2 and ctx dropout masking, a1390-human-TF list, v9 human motif-to-TF annotations and the hg38 RefSeq-r80 mc9nr500bp-up/100bp-down ranking database, followed by AUCell.
review.implementation_scope_note: Five percent of cells per broad cell type were sampled. mask_dropouts=True computes TF-target correlations using cells with nonzero expression. The pySCENIC version is not a standalone cisTarget edition. Native enrichment does not reproduce coexpression inference, dropout masking, regulon pruning, AUCell/RSS, Wilcoxon differential testing or igraph/ggraph network construction.

review.use_summary: Used pySCENIC0.12.1/GRNBoost2 on20000 sampled normalized/log-transformed nuclei with hg38_10kbp_up_10kbp_down_full_tx_v10 rankings and motifs-v10nr TF motifs from the cis-target database; then AUCell on the full dataset.
review.implementation_scope_note: Ranking and annotation resources feed pySCENIC. Per-sample/cell-type activity averaging and Wilcoxon comparisons are separate. A native cisTarget calculation does not reproduce GRNBoost2, regulon construction, AUCell or condition comparisons. No standalone cisTarget edition is specified.
